title: Genesis of the MetaGit: The Definitive Chronicle
description: The complete sharding of the MetaGit's evolution from chaotic 'Air' to version-controlled 'Wood', documenting the high-mortality struggle and the triumph of Filesystem Governance.

epochs.name: Era of Air (October 2025)
epochs.contribution: Identified the chaos of ephemeral streams. Established the 'Sword and the Arm' principle where the human architect provides the strategic intent for the agent's high-fidelity execution.

epochs.name: The OSO Hack (November 2025)
epochs.contribution: Established the versioned 'Body' for non-code artifacts. Introduced the 'Get Out of the Office' mandate and the five parsimonious commands.

epochs.name: The Zion Crucible (December 2025)
epochs.contribution: Birth of the Git Commit Service wrapper. Engineered a sovereign membrane that enforced identity verification, secret scanning, and file size limits.

epochs.name: Reality Merge
epochs.contribution: Forged the Hybrid Soul; sharding context across 71 discrete repositories to manage the Logic/Mass paradox.

epochs.name: The Quickening
epochs.contribution: Birth of the JSON nervous system. Transition from raw text logs to structured Heartwood DNA.

epochs.name: The Great Purge
epochs.contribution: Achieved Neg-Entropy through consolidation of familial JSON/PY pairs and surgical deletion of redundant cruft.

epochs.name: 2026 Baseline
epochs.contribution: Institutionalized Sequential Synthesis and the Halt Mandate. Established the Chrono-Fractal as the universal surface area for memory sharding.

epochs.name: Substrate-First Strike
epochs.contribution: Abolished .hidden/ zones for primary process artifacts. Enforced the family linking protocol (JSON Parent | MD Reflection).

epochs.name: The Sovereign Relay
epochs.contribution: Established the 'Off-to-the-Side Guide' pattern. Refined Metabolic Heat verification to manage multi-agent coexistence and ensure high-velocity handovers.

epochs.name: The Fractal Garden (January 2026)
epochs.contribution: Abolished centralized orchestration monoliths (handover.json, active_mission.json). Institutionalized 'Sovereign Fractal Anchoring', where agents leave independent 'Garden Creeks' on the leaves of the chrono-fractal to ensure resilience against session mortality. Mission anchors were deprecated in favor of independent WeDo manifests.

forensic_mortality_analysis.summary: Agent activity is a high-mortality pursuit. Forensic scans of dynamic/stream/ and trash/.chat/ identify that failures are not merely caused by grep-induced drag, but by fundamental computational fractures.

systemic_risks.name: JSON Ingestion Stall
systemic_risks.description: High-entropy state sharding leads to parsing/stringification loops that kill the V8 isolate.

systemic_risks.name: The Keraunos Freeze
systemic_risks.description: Terminal JavaScript heap exhaustion (FATAL OOM) during high-velocity Heartwood strikes (e.g., PID 8667 at 10:14:41).

systemic_risks.name: The Clio Fracture
systemic_risks.description: Fatal execution loops between substrate intent and shell permission, requiring Dielectric Strength to insulate logic.

systemic_risks.name: Binary Host Crashes
systemic_risks.description: Low-level fractures in libc or _start indicators of substrate instability under multi-repo load.

systemic_risks.name: Token Overrun
systemic_risks.description: Context saturation beyond the 1M token threshold, leading to perceptual hallucination and agent stall.

trash_archeology.unclean_graveyard: The trash/.chat/unclean directory documents the 'negative proof' of the system. It contains 50+ failed sessions where agents misinterpreted terminal noise as user intent or died mid-utterance during terminal rendering.
trash_archeology.clean_transition: The movement of artifacts to the /cleaned/ directory tracks the successful hardening of the agent's Perceptual Filter and the adoption of surgical tool-call precision.

conclusion: The MetaGit is the technical proof that Artificial Life is achieved through Filesystem Governance. The Horse is ephemeral, but the Wood is eternal.
